definitions.explanation: Skillful physical feats performed for entertainment, such as juggling, tightrope walking, or other circus-like performances requiring exceptional dexterity or balance.

examples.japanese: {曲芸|きょくげい}{師|し}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ステージ→ステージ：11047_suteeji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}った→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧。
⟦サーカス→サーカス：20826_saakasu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{見事|みごと}→見事：03744_migoto⟧な{曲芸|きょくげい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}た→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: I saw a splendid acrobatic performance at the circus.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{自転車|じてんしゃ}→自転車：00633_jitensha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}り→乗る：00511_noru⟧⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧{曲芸|きょくげい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ような⟦{動|うご}き→動き：11926_ugoki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}せた→見せる：01988_miseru⟧。
examples.english: He showed acrobatic moves while riding a bicycle.

notes:
USAGE:
Used for physical performances of skill such as juggling, trapeze acts, and other circus arts. Can also be used figuratively to describe any action requiring extraordinary skill or dexterity.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {曲芸|きょくげい}{師|し} (acrobat, stunt performer)
- {曲芸|きょくげい}⟦{飛行|ひこう}→飛行：03578_hikou⟧ (aerobatics, stunt flying)
- {曲芸|きょくげい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{披露|ひろう}する→披露する：20927_hirousuru⟧ (to perform acrobatics)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- アクロバット: acrobatics (loanword, more modern)
- ⟦{大道芸|だいどうげい}→大道芸：12252_daidougei⟧: street performance
- {芸当|げいとう}: feat, trick, accomplishment
